name: Zayan
reframe: his brain sees every possibility at once
physical_description: 9-year-old South Asian boy, tight dark curls, red hoodie with a frayed left cuff, scuffed white sneakers, always mid-motion
fear_carried_in: that the adults are right and he is just broken
story_premise: the school is trapped in a maze that reshuffles every thirty seconds, and only someone who tracks every corridor at once can find the way out
totem: a rubber band he snaps around his wrist
